literal: Shengzong, Part Seven
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Seven

literal: In the seventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiachen day, went to Dali Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tonghe, on jiachen day of the first spring month the court went to Dali Mountain.

literal: In the second month, on the yichou new moon, worshipped the sun, went to Hun River.
idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the second month the court worshipped the sun and went to Hun River.

literal: In the third month, on xinchou day, ordered the five northeastern tribes Yuelidu, Pouali, Aolimi, Punuli, and Tieli to submit yearly tribute of sixty-five thousand sable pelts and three hundred horses.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the third month the five northeastern tribes Yuelidu, Pouali, Aolimi, Punuli, and Tieli were ordered to submit yearly tribute of sixty-five thousand sable pelts and three hundred horses.

literal: On bingwu day, Wugu tribal military commissioner Xiao Puda attacked the rebel Dilie and destroyed him.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Xiao Puda attacked the rebel Dilie and destroyed him.

literal: In summer, fourth month, worshipped the sun.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court worshipped the sun.

literal: On bingyin day, relieved famine in Chuan and Rao prefectures.
idiomatic: On bingyin day famine relief was distributed in Chuan and Rao Prefectures.

literal: On xinwei day, relieved poverty in the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On xinwei day poverty relief was distributed in the Central Capital.

literal: On guiyou day, forbade anonymous letters.
idiomatic: On guiyou day anonymous letters were forbidden.

literal: On renchen day, made Three Departments commissioner Lü Demao Privy Vice Commissioner.
idiomatic: On renchen day Three Departments commissioner Lü Demao was appointed Privy Vice Commissioner.

literal: In the intercalary month, on renzi day, made Xiao Jinzhong Zhangwu Army military commissioner and concurrently commissioner for five prefectures.
idiomatic: On renzi day of the intercalary month Xiao Jinzhong was appointed Zhangwu Army military commissioner and concurrently commissioner for five prefectures.

literal: On wuwu day, Tibetan king Binglizun memorialized that for all tributary missions he begged passage through Xia State; permitted.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Tibetan king Binglizun memorialized that for all tributary missions he asked to pass through Xia territory; permission was granted.

literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.
idiomatic: On bingyin day of the fifth month Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.

literal: Made Zhang Jian acting Minister over the Masses and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.
idiomatic: Zhang Jian was appointed acting Minister over the Masses and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, Pindaluogui tribal military commissioner Boluri reached Bisa River, encountered light rain, suddenly heaven and earth darkened, and a strong wind swept forty-three men spinning through the air; after a long time they fell several li away.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the sixth month Pindaluogui tribal military commissioner Boluri reached Bisa River in light rain when heaven and earth suddenly darkened; a strong wind swept forty-three men spinning through the air, and after a long time they fell several li away.

literal: Boluri fortunately escaped unharmed.
idiomatic: Boluri fortunately escaped unharmed.

literal: One wine jug on the ground did not move at all.
idiomatic: One wine jug on the ground did not move at all.

literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, performed the great willow-shooting rite.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the eighth month the court performed the great willow-shooting rite.

literal: On gengshen day, appointed Yelü Liuning and Wu Shouda as envoys to Song to congratulate the birthday, and Xiao Gaojiu and Ma Yimou as envoys to Song to congratulate New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Yelü Liuning and Wu Shouda were appointed envoys to Song to congratulate the Emperor's birthday, and Xiao Gaojiu and Ma Yimou envoys to Song to congratulate New Year's Day.

literal: Promoted Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Hongyi to Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors, Esteemed Father, and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.
idiomatic: Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Hongyi was promoted to Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors, Esteemed Father, and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, edict ordered Hanlin awaiting-draft Chen Sheng to paint the Victory Chart of the Southern Campaign at the Five Phoenix Hall in the Upper Capital.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered Hanlin awaiting-draft Chen Sheng to paint the Victory Chart of the Southern Campaign at the Five Phoenix Hall in the Upper Capital.

literal: On dingmao day, the Punuli tribe came with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Punuli tribe came with tribute.

literal: In the ninth month, on the gengshen new moon, the Punii envoy memorialized that his country and Wuli country share borders and had repeatedly raided each other causing unrest; an edict was issued to instruct them. On wuchen day, edict ordered inner and outer officials who accept bribes in connection with matters and, when discovered, claim it was done by children or servants, forbidden.
idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month the Punii envoy reported that his country and Wuli shared a border and had repeatedly raided each other; an edict was issued to instruct them. On wuchen day an edict forbade inner and outer officials who accept bribes and, when discovered, blame children or servants.

literal: On gengwu day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On gengwu day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Requisitioned horses for the eastern expedition army.
idiomatic: Horses were requisitioned for the eastern expedition army.

literal: That month, halted at Tuhe River valley.
idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Tuhe River valley.

literal: In winter, tenth month, named two newly built halls in the Central Capital Yanqing and Yongan.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month two newly built halls in the Central Capital were named Yanqing and Yongan.

literal: On renyin day, made Shunyi Army military commissioner Shi Yongzhong Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander.
idiomatic: On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shi Yongzhong was appointed Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander.

literal: On bingchen day, edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general, to campaign against Goryeo.
idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo.

literal: Also instructed Goryeo garrison officials that those who could lead their people to surrender would be richly rewarded, while those who held fast and resisted would regret too late.
idiomatic: Goryeo garrison officials were also told that those who led their people to surrender would be richly rewarded, while those who held fast would regret it too late.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renxu day, made Lü Demao to manage the Ministry of Personnel, Yang Youxuan to manage the Detailed Review Bureau, Liu Sheng Ba Prefecture military commissioner, and Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Shenxing Zhangwu Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On renxu day of the eleventh month Lü Demao was assigned to manage the Ministry of Personnel, Yang Youxuan the Detailed Review Bureau, Liu Sheng was made Ba Prefecture military commissioner, and Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Shenxing Zhangwu Army military commissioner.

literal: On gengchen day, forbade wearing bright gold, filigree gold, and gold leaf.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the wearing of bright gold, filigree gold, and gold leaf was forbidden.

literal: On wuzi day, favored visit to the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: In the twelfth month, on dingyou day, Song sent Lü Yijian and Cao Zhang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the twelfth month Song sent Lü Yijian and Cao Zhang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: That month, Xiao Paiya and others fought Goryeo at the Cha and Tuo rivers; the Liao army was defeated, and many from the Tianyun and Right Pishi armies drowned; Yaolian tent xiangwen Aguoda, Reception Bureau commissioner Zhuogu, Bohai xiangwen Gao Qingming, Tianyun Army xiangwen Haili, and others all died.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Paiya and others fought Goryeo at the Cha and Tuo rivers; the Liao army was defeated and many from the Tianyun and Right Pishi armies drowned; Yaolian tent xiangwen Aguoda, Reception Bureau commissioner Zhuogu, Bohai xiangwen Gao Qingming, Tianyun Army xiangwen Haili, and others all died.

literal: Palace examination: jinshi Zhang Kegong and thirty-seven others passed and were granted degrees.
idiomatic: At the palace examination jinshi Zhang Kegong and thirty-seven others passed and were granted degrees.

literal: In the eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun to congratulate.
idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations.

literal: On renxu day, Tieli came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renxu day Tieli came with tribute.

literal: Built Emperor Jingzong temple at the Central Capital.
idiomatic: Emperor Jingzong's temple was built at the Central Capital.

literal: Enfeoffed Shazhou military commissioner Cao Shun as Prince of Dunhuang commandery.
idiomatic: Shazhou military commissioner Cao Shun was enfeoffed as Prince of Dunhuang commandery.

literal: In the second month, on dingwei day, made former Southern Privy Commissioner Han Zhixin Central Capital regent and Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Wang Jizhong Southern Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the second month former Southern Privy Commissioner Han Zhixin was made Central Capital regent and Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Wang Jizhong Southern Privy Commissioner.

literal: On bingchen day, sacrificed to the Wind Lord.
idiomatic: On bingchen day sacrifice was offered to the Wind Lord.

literal: In the third month, on jiwei day, made Khitan Hongyi Palace commissioner Heshi Xingsheng Palace metropolitan garrison commander, former Yao'en nian tribal military commissioner Kongguli Jiqing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, and Left attendant langjun Yelü Han Fourth Victory Army inspector general.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the third month Khitan Hongyi Palace commissioner Heshi was made Xingsheng Palace metropolitan garrison commander, former Yao'en nian tribal military commissioner Kongguli Jiqing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, and Left attendant langjun Yelü Han Fourth Victory Army inspector general.

literal: On yihai day, Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; they were charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated, and they were released.
idiomatic: On yihai day Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated and they were released.

literal: On jimao day, edict added ranks for Bohai officers who had merit in the Goryeo campaign.
idiomatic: On jimao day an edict added ranks for Bohai officers who had merit in the Goryeo campaign.

literal: On renwu day, inspected Flying Dragon Court horses.
idiomatic: On renwu day the Flying Dragon Court horses were inspected.

literal: On guiwei day, Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Talage came with tribute.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Talage came with tribute.

literal: On bingxu day, established Eastern Capital Bohai attendance officer metropolitan director and ranking supervisor.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Eastern Capital Bohai attendance officer metropolitan director and ranking supervisor was established.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on the wuzi new moon, went to Mian Mountain.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the fourth summer month the court went to Mian Mountain.

literal: In the fifth month, on renshen day, made imperial son-in-law Xiao Kezhong Changning Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the fifth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Kezhong was appointed Changning Army military commissioner.

literal: On yihai day, relocated Ning Prefecture Bohai households between the Liao and Tu rivers.
idiomatic: On yihai day Ning Prefecture Bohai households were relocated between the Liao and Tu rivers.

literal: On jimao day, Hesuguan tiyin Abuge and chancellor Saila came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jimao day Hesuguan tiyin Abuge and chancellor Saila came with tribute.

literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, enrolled children of officers who died in the Goryeo campaign.
idiomatic: On wuzi day of the sixth month children of officers who died in the Goryeo campaign were enrolled.

literal: On jichou day, made Left yilibi Xiao Jieli Southwestern Pacification commissioner and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yaozhi yilibi.
idiomatic: On jichou day Left yilibi Xiao Jieli was appointed Southwestern Pacification commissioner and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yaozhi yilibi.

literal: On yihai day, made tiyin Yelü Hege Southern Chancellery chancellor and Southern linya Yelü Hanliu tiyin.
idiomatic: On yihai day tiyin Yelü Hege was made Southern Chancellery chancellor and Southern linya Yelü Hanliu tiyin.

literal: On guimao day, relaxed the prohibition on timber harvesting at Dabai Mountain and Yuanling.
idiomatic: On guimao day the prohibition on timber harvesting at Dabai Mountain and Yuanling was relaxed.

literal: On yisi day, because Southern Pishi Army officers and others had merit campaigning against Goryeo, granted gold and silk with distinctions.
idiomatic: On yisi day Southern Pishi Army officers and others were granted gold and silk in varying amounts for merit in the Goryeo campaign.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiwei day, for generals who died campaigning against Goryeo, edict increased enfeoffments for their wives.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the seventh autumn month an edict increased enfeoffments for the wives of generals who died in the Goryeo campaign.

literal: On gengshen day, made Northeastern Route xiangwen Yelü Dujie Northern Chancellery Great King.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Northeastern Route xiangwen Yelü Dujie was made Northern Chancellery Great King.

literal: On xinyou day, the Yaoli and Niege two Xi armies had merit in the Goryeo campaign; all were granted gold and silk.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the Yaoli and Niege Xi armies were granted gold and silk for merit in the Goryeo campaign.

literal: On guihai day, edict ordered Zubu to continue yearly tribute of one thousand seven hundred horses, four hundred forty camels, ten thousand sable-mouse pelts, and twenty-five thousand blue-mouse pelts.
idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered Zubu to continue yearly tribute of one thousand seven hundred horses, four hundred forty camels, ten thousand sable-mouse pelts, and twenty-five thousand blue-mouse pelts.

literal: On wuchen day, inspected crops.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the court inspected the crops.

literal: On jisi day, Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Mamne came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jisi day Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Mamne came with tribute.

literal: On gengwu day, inspected the market and granted partial amnesty to prisoners held in the market.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the court inspected the market and granted partial amnesty to prisoners held there.

literal: Appointed Jiening and Ma Yi as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.
idiomatic: Jiening and Ma Yi were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday.

literal: In the eighth month, on gengyin day, dispatched langjun Hebulu and others to lead various tribal troops to join the main army against Goryeo.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the eighth month langjun Hebulu and others were dispatched to lead various tribal troops to join the main army against Goryeo.

literal: In the ninth month, on jisi day, made Shi Yongzhong Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner.
idiomatic: On jisi day of the ninth month Shi Yongzhong was appointed Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner.

literal: Song sent Cui Zundu and Wang Yingchang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: Song sent Cui Zundu and Wang Yingchang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: On renshen day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On renshen day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On jiaxu day, again reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day prisoners were reviewed again.

literal: On gengchen day, Hesuguan tiyin Abugo came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Hesuguan tiyin Abugo came with tribute.

literal: On renwu day, halted at Tuhe River valley.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court encamped at Tuhe River valley.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on yiyou day, edict to all circuits that matters great and small already decided were to be reported itemized once every three months.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered all circuits to report decided matters great and small in itemized lists once every three months.

literal: On wuzi day, dispatched Yelü Jichong and Zheng Xuanxia to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Yelü Jichong and Zheng Xuanxia were dispatched to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

literal: On guisi day, edict that the three horizontal-tent houses may not marry with low small-tent clans;
idiomatic: On guisi day an edict forbade the three horizontal-tent houses to marry with low small-tent clans;

literal: all marriages must be memorialized before proceeding.
idiomatic: all marriages had to be memorialized before proceeding.

literal: On guimao day, made former Northern Chancellery Great King Jianfu azagazhi.
idiomatic: On guimao day former Northern Chancellery Great King Jianfu was made azagazhi.

literal: On jiachen day, changed Eastern Route Haoli Grand Guardian city to Xian Prefecture and established a military commission to govern it.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Eastern Route Haoli Grand Guardian city was renamed Xian Prefecture and a military commission was established to govern it.

literal: In the eleventh month, on jiayin day, established Xuande County in Yun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiayin day of the eleventh month Xuande County was established in Yun Prefecture.

literal: In the twelfth month, on xinmao day, halted at the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the twelfth month the court encamped at the Central Capital.

literal: On yisi day, made Prince of Guangping Zongye Central Capital regent and Dading intendant, and Han Zhixin tiyin.
idiomatic: On yisi day Prince of Guangping Zongye was made Central Capital regent and Dading intendant, and Han Zhixin tiyin.

literal: On xinhai day, Goryeo King Xun dispatched envoys begging to submit tribute goods; edict accepted them.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Goryeo King Xun sent envoys asking to resume tribute; an edict accepted their submission.

literal: In the ninth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu to congratulate.
idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu with congratulations.

literal: In the second month, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial requesting to call himself a vassal and submit tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.
idiomatic: On gengwu day of the fifth month Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial asking to resume vassal status and tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.

literal: Zhilali had been in Goryeo six years, maintained loyal integrity unyielding, and was made linya.
idiomatic: Zhilali had spent six years in Goryeo with loyal integrity unbroken and was made linya.

literal: On xinwei day, dispatched envoys to release King Xun from guilt and granted his request.
idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to absolve King Xun and grant his request.

literal: On guiyou day, made Yelü Zongjiao Acting Grand Mentor, Zonghui Qisheng Army military commissioner, and Liu Sheng Crown Prince Grand Tutor, also granting the Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity title.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Yelü Zongjiao was made Acting Grand Mentor, Zonghui Qisheng Army military commissioner, and Liu Sheng Crown Prince Grand Tutor, and all were granted the Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity title.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the gengxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse; edict ordered close ministers to perform sun-rescue rites on the Emperor's behalf.
idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse; an edict ordered close ministers to perform sun-rescue rites on the Emperor's behalf.

literal: On jiayin day, dispatched envoys to grant Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun clothing.
idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to grant Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun clothing.

literal: Made Zhala, Geng Yuanji, Han Jiu, and Song Zhang chief and deputy envoys for the next year to congratulate Song on the birthday and New Year's Day.
idiomatic: Zhala, Geng Yuanji, Han Jiu, and Song Zhang were appointed chief and deputy envoys for the following year to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day.

literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu day, made imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong Associate Grand Chancellor.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the ninth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed Associate Grand Chancellor.

literal: On dingmao day, civil and military hundred officials submitted a memorial offering an honorific title; not permitted;
idiomatic: On dingmao day the civil and military hundred officials submitted a memorial offering an honorific title; permission was refused;

literal: submitted three times, then permitted.
idiomatic: after three submissions permission was granted.

literal: On yihai day, Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On yihai day Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Requisitioned Han Chinese civilian horses from all circuits to grant the eastern expedition army.
idiomatic: Han civilian horses from all circuits were requisitioned for the eastern expedition army.

literal: Made yilibi Yanning vice metropolitan horses-and-army garrison commander to command troops on the eastern expedition.
idiomatic: Yilibi Yanning was appointed vice metropolitan horses-and-army garrison commander to command the eastern expedition.

literal: That month, halted at Jinping Marsh.
idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Jinping Marsh.

literal: Song sent Song Shou and Luo Jilun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: Song sent Song Shou and Luo Jilun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on the wuyin new moon, made Nieli Xi King inspector general and Tudieli Northern Prince's House Sheli Army xiangwen.
idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the tenth winter month Nieli was made Xi King inspector general and Tudieli Northern Prince's House Sheli Army xiangwen.
